name: BanglaRegionalTextCorpus: Curated Dataset for Four Regional Bangla Dialects
description: A manually curated linguistic dataset comprising 4,653 Bengali sentences representing four regional dialects of Bangladesh: Rangpur, Barisal, Narail, and Khulna, paired with Standard Bangla and English translations. Collected through community interactions, field recordings, and online sources, followed by linguistic validation from native speakers for dialect identification and regional machine translation.
